description: On the table there’s a tall black cylindrical tube with a red lid, and a light-colored shirt lying beside it. The left hand steadies the tube while the right hand lifts the shirt, drapes it over the tube’s opening, and repeatedly pushes and stuffs the fabric down inside; the right hand then withdraws, picks up the red lid, and presses it back onto the tube while the left hand continues holding the tube as a left-hand object.
